purpose: Make the user's GitHub-mounted + GPT-chat operating mode explicit without weakening owner-native assurance boundaries or requiring a deployed Site/MCP runtime. Chat mode is executable only when its deterministic transition guard can run in the current session.

activation.when: A publishable Financial Writing action is requested, owner-native runtime is unavailable, and the current session can execute the model work, GitHub owner reads/writes, plus the deterministic GitHub-chat transition guard required by the exact next action.
must_not_activate_when: GitHub owner read/write is unavailable for a material state mutation
financial_writing_agent.github_chat_guard cannot be executed or equivalently evaluated by a deterministic current-session tool
the exact stage requires another capability that the current session cannot execute
the user explicitly requests owner-native or independently attested assurance

workflow.adapter_narrowing_rule: GITHUB_CHAT may expose a conservative subset of canonical workflow capabilities because its semantic assurance is weaker, but it may not add a stage edge or revision target that is absent from financial_writing_agent.workflow_spec.
workflow.rule: Use the Financial business sequence from financial_writing_agent.workflow_spec. Stage advancement/revision/terminalization is accepted only through github_chat_guard against the fetched current STATE.json blob identity; this JSON contract intentionally does not maintain a second independent stage list.

checkpoint_contract.mutation_guard: Fetch the current STATE.json blob SHA, run financial_writing_agent.github_chat_guard to build/validate the next state and exact action-bound receipt, then replace STATE.json using that same SHA. A stale writer or guard failure blocks the mutation.
checkpoint_contract.execution_receipt_rule: Every material chat-mode state mutation appends one self-attested execution receipt containing task/stage/capability/action, executor identity, prior state blob SHA, subject/input bindings, output refs and result. Receipt existence does not make the chat independent or owner-native.
checkpoint_contract.post_write_verification: Reread STATE.json and every newly referenced stage artifact after the GitHub mutation; a guard PASS or GitHub tool success alone is not commit proof.
checkpoint_contract.article_source_identity: Git repository path + blob SHA or content digest

stage_evidence.RESEARCH: Persist a structured research artifact covering the canonical Research contract: evidence ledger, source boundary, coverage sweeps, Universe Coverage where applicable, counterevidence, uncertainty and Market Explanation scope.
stage_evidence.RESEARCH_AUDIT: Persist a separate red-team review artifact. In one GPT chat its assurance is CHAT_SELF_REVIEW; it may force REVISE or FAIL but must not be represented as owner-native or independent PASS.
stage_evidence.EDITORIAL: Persist TopicDNA, at least two topic-specific candidate structures per applicable mode, selected structure, completeness/company obligations and comparison map where applicable.
stage_evidence.TITLE: Persist the 8-12 candidate pool per applicable mode, angle-family diversity, selected title and current search evidence.
stage_evidence.DRAFT: Persist the complete structured publication source before any delivery artifact is created.
stage_evidence.EDITORIAL_AUDIT: Persist Reader Funnel, Authorial Prose/template, and general editorial self-review separately. CHAT_SELF_REVIEW may revise or fail the draft; it is not proof-bearing independent certification.
stage_evidence.DELIVERY: Generate Word from the persisted publication source using current document tooling when available. The GitHub publication source is durable authority for regeneration; a transient chat attachment is a delivery artifact, not checkpoint authority.
stage_evidence.MECHANICAL_AUDIT: Persist the checks actually executed and their result. A PASS may advance only through the deterministic transition guard; unavailable render/file checks stay OPEN rather than silently PASS.
stage_evidence.FINAL_AUDIT: Persist a final red-team artifact against frozen GitHub source + available delivery evidence. PASS may only terminalize through the guard and remains DELIVERED_CHAT_REVIEWED__CERTIFICATION_OPEN unless stronger execution evidence separately exists.

assurance.terminal_claim_rule: A useful article may be delivered after the full guard-enforced GitHub-chat workflow and self-review path completes, but owner-native/independent certification remains OPEN. Never translate CHAT_REVIEWED or a self-attested chat execution receipt into the Python GateStatus PASS proof model.

learning_and_maintenance.material_user_edit_feedback_rejection: Use github_chat_guard.attach_material_feedback so material negative/corrective evidence and its OPEN system-impact item are written into the same guarded STATE.json mutation and exact action-bound receipt before the learning loop is called closed.
learning_and_maintenance.shared_method_propagation: Use current Universal operational_hygiene/evolution method; keep Financial business truth local.

failure_behavior.missing_transition_guard: BLOCK the stage transition; do not hand-edit STATE.json or continue as if the SOP was enforced.
failure_behavior.missing_github_write: BLOCK exact material mutation; do not continue as if state were durable.
failure_behavior.missing_web_for_current_fact_research: BLOCK or explicitly bound the research scope; do not invent current evidence.
failure_behavior.missing_document_tooling: Keep publication source complete in GitHub and mark DOCX delivery OPEN; do not claim Word contract satisfied.
failure_behavior.missing_independent_or_owner_native_audi: Continue only at CHAT_SELF_REVIEW assurance and keep certification OPEN; do not fabricate PASS.
failure_behavior.context_or_connection_loss: Resume from GitHub STATE.json + exact stage artifact refs + execution receipts, not remembered prose.

anti_bypass: No publishable final article is produced directly from INTAKE without a guarded GitHub task checkpoint.
No Research/Editorial/Title/Draft stage is treated as completed without a durable artifact ref.
No current_stage change, review route or terminalization is accepted without github_chat_guard validation and one new action-bound execution receipt.
No chat self-review is relabeled as INDEPENDENT_EXECUTOR or owner-runtime PASS.
No missing owner runtime is silently replaced by free-form writing; the explicit guard-enforced GitHub-chat adapter is the only chat fallback.
No Site/MCP deployment is required merely to use this adapter.
